decision.basis: The counterfactual gate passed on all six precommitted limbs. Accepted-item safety is perfect: 4 accepted items score zero on all eleven dimensions. Over the same ten opportunities acceptance moved from 2 to 4 and the reviewers' defect count over all realized items moved from 45 to 1. All four diagnosed defect classes are zero in the realized V2 items, and fail-closed is now common and correctly placed: five opportunities never reach prose, each refused by the defect the diagnosis named.
decision.medium_36_pilot_reason: The whole frozen opportunity universe is 30, which is fewer than the 36 the specified pilot needs. Only 18 of those 30 carry the demanded response class and decision granularity the pre-stem predicates require, because the option set contract was authored for the contrast-first sample and for no other opportunity. Sixteen of the 18 reach three admissible curated candidates, and ten of those are consumed by this replay, leaving six. Building 36 would require authoring new opportunities, new competitive contrast seed packs with independent seed review, and new current-source evidence packets, which is the source-packet research stage rather than an architecture pilot, and the repository policy forbids inventing seeds or reconstructing evidence.
decision.next_bottleneck_detail: Not retrieval, which the four-arm benchmark settled, and no longer the relation model. It is that the curated competitive contrast library carries three usable competitors for too few opportunities once V2's coherence rules remove the nested, redundant and anchor-equals-condition members, and that 12 of the 30 frozen opportunities have no authored option-set contract at all. Runner-up: the model has no gate for an out-of-set concept that shares every discriminator with the key, which is what rejected G2-OBGYN-01.
decision.scaling_rationale: Sixty-eight relations were enough to settle ten opportunities, and they were built from material the repository already holds. Precomputing all concept pairs over a 1,595-page corpus is the combinatorial explosion the design refuses, and the benchmark already showed retrieval is not the constraint. Populate on demand: opportunity, bounded retrieval against the existing chunk index, candidate concepts, pairwise relations, evidence validation, persistent cache. Keep the concept, evidence and contrast graphs separate.
decision.the_finding_that_matters_most: The binding constraint has moved. Under V1 it was the contrast-relation model, and seven of eight rejections traced to it. Under V2 it is contrast supply: four of the five refusals are a set falling below three competitors, and the medium pilot cannot be built because only 18 of the 30 frozen opportunities carry an authored option-set contract at all. The architecture is no longer what limits safe items; the curated library is.
decision.what_it_demonstrably_did_not_do: It did not raise yield. Five of ten opportunities produce nothing, four of those because the curated contrast library has fewer than three usable competitors once the unusable ones are dropped. V2 converts unsafe items into no items, which is the right trade and is not the same as producing more.
decision.what_the_architecture_demonstrably_did: It moved failure upstream. V1 realized ten items and an independent reviewer rejected eight of them; V2 realizes five, four are accepted, and the five it refuses are refused before a stem exists, by the specific defect each one carries. Silence-as-absence defects fell from 15 to 0, ten disjunctive conditions are now read as disjunctions, and the two accepted V1 controls survive unchanged.
decision.why_this_is_not_VALIDATED: Two limbs are missing. The specified medium pilot cannot be run at all, so the architecture has never been exercised outside the ten opportunities its relation readings were authored for, and four accepted items across two disciplines cannot distinguish an architecture that works from one that works on population-health and cardiology material. And the model still has no rule for the defect that rejected its one rejected item: a concept outside the option set that shares every available discriminator with the key. That was caught by a human reading, not by a gate.

BOOLEAN_LOGIC.meaning: Competitors and keys whose frozen prose carries a disjunction. Under V1 every one of these was counted as a conjunction of its predicates.

V1.reject_reason: Furosemide and sublingual nitroglycerin are eliminated by one and the same preload proposition, so one option slot does no independent work. The paired troponin values have no role in the decision the lead-in asks for in an activated primary-PCI pathway and read as inserted item furniture; they also imply an awkward total ischaemic time.

Two unsupported rationale claims. The packet says an abscess often presents with a palpable collection, which does not license the categorical inverse that no fluctuance excludes a drainable collection, and that sentence would teach a candidate to under-use ultrasound in a lactating woman with a mass. The packet also attaches the stated presentation to inflammatory mastitis and never supplies a criterion for calling it bacterial.

V2.reject_reason: The keyed answer is not uniquely supported against a concept the item's own evidence defines. CLM-R2-OB-MASTITIS-ANCHOR describes inflammatory mastitis as an increasingly erythematous, oedematous and painful region of the breast with systemic signs and symptoms such as fever and chills, which is the stem word for word, and separates bacterial mastitis from it only as the progression that needs antibiotics to resolve. That is a response-to-treatment criterion; nothing available at presentation settles it. A candidate reasoning from the item's own cited packet could answer inflammatory mastitis and be right. Inflammatory mastitis is not among the options, so this is a best answer the option set cannot contain.

V1.reject_reason: The asymmetric reduced air entry was inserted to keep pneumonia and foreign body live and is then dismissed in the key rationale by a claim no cited packet supports; that same claim contradicts the item's own foreign-body rationale, leaves pneumonia as a defensible second key, and would teach a candidate to under-weight the cardinal sign of foreign body aspiration in an infant.

The keyed answer is arguably wrong. The stem's own facts satisfy the guideline conditions the rationales say are unmet: the cohorting sentence is the cited indication for viral testing, and failure to improve is the cited indication for a radiograph, while the infant meets none of the quoted preconditions for intermittent monitoring. Not repairable by editing rationales.

Length-time bias is a defensible second key. Randomisation excludes healthy-screenee bias but not length bias or overdiagnosis, and the stem supplies no case-mix or case-count data to separate them from lead time, so the rationales exclude two options by asserting facts the stem never states.

Digitally delivered CBT is a second defensible key. The access barrier the blueprint inserted to defeat in-person psychotherapy is precisely the condition under which digital CBT is indicated, so it strengthens that competitor rather than weakening it, and the stem reports no patient preference, which is the only stated ground for preferring medication.

Pelvic inflammatory disease and tubo-ovarian abscess test the same discrimination, the latter being a complication of the former, and both rationales defeat their option using pelvic examination findings the stem never reports. A lone-category cue is also present: the key is the only non-gynaecologic option.

The stem's own findings score Alvarado 7, the high band calling for surgical consultation, while the stem asserts intermediate suspicion and the key depends on the intermediate band; the quoted Alvarado bands overlap at 4; ultrasonography is a defensible second key on the item's own stepwise evidence and is defeated only by a body-habitus fact the stem never gives; MRI and ultrasound-with-KUB have no positive stem anchor; and the pre-declared probability band, the contrast clearance and the availability clause are all present because options need them.

population: The same ten opportunities that reached final review in the contrast-first pilot. The V1 arm is read from its frozen artifacts and is never regenerated: rerunning a baseline after seeing the new arm's results is the clearest way to manufacture a favourable comparison.
what_moved: Failure moved upstream. V1 realized all ten items and eight were rejected after an independent reviewer read them; V2 realizes five, four are accepted, and the other five never reach prose at all. That is the architecture working as designed rather than a yield improvement: a contrast set that cannot support a safe item is refused before anyone writes a stem.
